StudentCareer.title: StudentCareer
StudentCareer.description: Represents a player's active or completed University of Nigeria (UNN/UNEC) student simulation career.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this career.

studentName.description: Full name of the Lion or Lioness student.

campus.description: UNN Nsukka main campus or UNEC Enugu campus.

hostel.description: Assigned hall of residence or off-campus lodge (e.g., Zik's Flats, Bello Hall, Odenigwe).

week.description: Current week of the semester (1 to 14).

sanity.description: Mental composure and peace of mind (0 to 100).

streetCred.description: Campus popularity and social hierarchy standing (0 to 100).

politicalClout.description: SUG and faculty political influence (0 to 100).

sugOffice.description: Current Student Union Government or departmental position.

isGraduated.description: Whether the student has completed their UNN journey.

inventory.description: Bounded list of owned campus survival items (max 25).

relationships.description: Bounded list of NPC relationship states (max 25).

recentLogs.description: Bounded list of recent campus diary log entries (max 30).

badges.description: Bounded list of earned UNN achievement badges (max 25).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the career was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the career was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AlumniRecord.title: AlumniRecord
AlumniRecord.description: Represents a completed graduation or convocation Hall of Fame record for a user's UNN student.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this alumni record.

degreeClass.description: Honours classification (e.g., First Class Honours, Second Class Upper).

finalTitle.description: Campus legacy title earned upon convocation.

summary.description: Narrative summary of the student's 4-year UNN journey.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/careers/{careerId}.description: Stores active and past UNN student simulation careers scoped to the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/hall_of_fame/{recordId}.description: Stores convocation and graduation Hall of Fame records scoped to the authenticated user.
